exact_holds.reason: Original ANSI/VITA 65.0 §6.5 profile definitions remain unread; source cross-reference is not inspection.
Original ANSI/VITA 65.1 ANS single-field construction native text not independently audited.
Original VITA 66 connector module and MT physical specification unavailable here; no exact vendor connector compatibility inferred.
C239-native DSDM, IDL and six OpenAPI original files remain uninspected; no invented API fields.
Original PDF text page 265 and three table examples read; independent page-image geometry unavailable; do not claim pixel/table-cell verification.
Printed VANSI/ITA 65.1 typography is preserved as original source anomaly; no normative interpretation based on editing it.
No-skipped-pipes 'must' is within a conditional textual construction; not automatically a new CSAPI Profile SHALL.
Unused fibers are only allowed under source Optical Profile marking and single-field pattern; no blanket 'skip anything' assertion.
Protocol field port count describes design usage; it cannot establish installed or operating optical channels.
Three table string examples and three MT profiles are illustrative, not exhaustive ANS grammar or all allowed connector setups.
100GBASE-SR4 and Aurora up-to-10-Gbaud codes are examples, not actual throughput or installed hardware capability.
All 19 G2-7C and 17 G2-7D original/source/visual holds remain open; §13.3.6 does not complete their matrix audits.
Four empirical equipment cases do not establish as-installed VITA66 modules/MTs and signal pipes.
Later S251 edition and its companion bundle not inspected; no assertion of 2025/2026 change or removal.
No universal physical chassis, DIM class/cardinality, CSAPI Profile SHALL or independent conformance adopted.
Original §13.3.7 has numbered rules but is explicitly outside the G2-7E authorized boundary; requires separate owner Proceed.
